text_blocks.snippet: The Janssen COVID-19 vaccine, also known as the Johnson & Johnson vaccine, is a single-dose adenovirus vector vaccine that was developed to prevent COVID-19. It was authorized for emergency use in the United States on February 27, 2021. However, the vaccine's emergency use authorization (EUA) expired on June 1, 2023.
